4.  **Cable reels**: 240 (initial) + 240 (added in turn t056) = 480
5.  **Toolkits**: 230 (initial) + 230 (added in turn t068) = 460

Now, I will sum these subtotals:
120 (Lanterns)
+ 360 (Ladders)
+ 440 (Tarps)
+ 480 (Cable reels)
+ 460 (Toolkits)
-------

480 + 440 = 920
920 + 480 = 1400
